_comment: Curated seed library of VERIFIED, REAL true stories about ordinary people who gamed the system - lottery loopholes, bank/ATM glitches, money hacks, advantage plays, arbitrage. These are all real published stories (major outlets: CBS, NYT, Guardian, BBC, Vice, etc). The pipeline draws from this pool FIRST (guaranteed on-topic + real), then falls back to HN Algolia search + RSS feeds for fresh material. Add verified stories here to grow the pool. Each entry: title, url, category, one-line beat.

stories.title: Jerry and Marge Selbee: how a retired couple won millions using a lottery loophole
stories.beat: A Michigan retired couple exploited a legal flaw in the Winfall lottery - buying huge volumes of losing tickets when the jackpot rolled down made the expected value positive - and quietly won $26 million over nine years.

stories.title: Jerry and Marge go large: the Selbee lottery loophole payoff
stories.beat: Follow-up on the Selbees: how the retired couple scaled their lottery roll-down arbitrage into a multi-million-dollar operation and what happened when MIT students discovered the same edge.

stories.title: Dan Saunders: the Australian bartender who blew $1.6 million on an ATM glitch
stories.beat: A Sydney bartender discovered a bank glitch let him withdraw more than his balance, blew roughly $1.6 million on a spending spree, then went to prison - and Australia's highest court later quashed his fraud convictions.

stories.title: Crypto.com accidentally transferred $10.5 million to an Australian woman
stories.beat: A refund typo at Crypto.com sent $10.5 million to a Melbourne woman who never asked for it - she bought a mansion, and a legal battle followed over whether she had to give it back.

stories.title: The Crypto.com $10.5 million accidental transfer trial
stories.beat: The court case over the Crypto.com $10.5 million windfall: the woman and her partner claimed they thought it was a prize, while the exchange fought to claw the money back.

stories.title: The man who blew a fortune when the bank paid out on a glitch
stories.beat: An Australian man discovered an unlimited-credit bank error and went on a wild spending spree - the story of what happens when a banking glitch hands someone a fortune.

stories.title: The Pudding Guy: how David Phillips flew around the world for free on pudding
stories.beat: A California man bought $3,000 of Healthy Choice pudding to cash in a 10 million frequent-flyer-mile promotion, then spent years flying first-class around the world - the original points arbitrage.

stories.title: Planet Money: The Pudding Guy
stories.beat: NPR's Planet Money on the man who gamed a frequent-flyer miles promotion by buying pudding - a perfect example of legal arbitrage against a marketing loophole.

stories.title: How MIT students worked a system to win the Massachusetts lottery
stories.beat: MIT students found a legal edge in the Massachusetts Cash WinFall lottery - a roll-down jackpot mechanic that made buying tickets in bulk mathematically profitable.

stories.title: Joan Ginther won the lottery four times: luck or math?
stories.beat: A Texas statistics professor won major lottery jackpots four separate times - the Washington Post investigates whether it was a mathematical edge, not luck.

stories.title: How Stefan Mandel won the lottery 14 times using mathematics
stories.beat: Romanian-Australian economist Stefan Mandel mathematically covered the entire ticket space to guarantee wins, beating 14 different lotteries across the world.

stories.title: The Australian man who spent $2.1 million after a bank glitch - convictions quashed
stories.beat: An Australian man went on a spending spree after a bank glitch gave him endless credit; his fraud convictions were later quashed by the country's highest court.

stories.title: Runaway millionaires: Leo Gao and Kara Hurring
stories.beat: A New Zealand couple were accidentally given a multi-million-dollar overdraft by Westpac, fled to China, and triggered an international manhunt.

stories.title: The Chase Bank 'infinite money' check glitch
stories.beat: A Chase Bank glitch let customers write and deposit checks they couldn't cover, briefly creating 'infinite money' - and viral TikTokers tried to exploit it.

stories.title: JPMorgan sues customers over the TikTok bank glitch
stories.beat: JPMorgan sued customers who exploited a check-deposit glitch that went viral on TikTok, trying to claw back the 'infinite money' withdrawals.

stories.title: The power of arbitrage
stories.beat: A conceptual look at arbitrage - buying where something is underpriced and selling where it is overpriced - the quiet edge at the heart of many money hacks.

stories.title: Is there a secret formula to winning the lottery?
stories.beat: An exploration of whether lotteries with roll-down jackpots can be beaten mathematically - and the real examples of people who did it.

stories.title: The mint coins credit-card hack
stories.beat: People exploited a credit-card rewards loophole by buying thousands of dollars of US Mint coins that were shipped free, then paying them off for profit and miles.

stories.title: How this couple won $26 million in the lottery
stories.beat: The story of the Michigan couple who legally beat the lottery with a roll-down jackpot flaw and turned $26 million in winnings into a business.

stories.title: Chase Bank TikTok infinite-money glitch check fraud
stories.beat: CBS on the Chase check-deposit glitch that went viral on TikTok - customers who thought they'd found an infinite-money hack and the fraud fallout.

stories.title: How this math genius won the lottery 14 times
stories.beat: CNBC on Romanian mathematician Stefan Mandel, who used combinatorics to cover every ticket combination and legally win 14 lotteries.

stories.title: Crypto.com accidentally sent a woman $10.5 million and didn't notice for months
stories.beat: Bloomberg's investigation into how Crypto.com lost track of a $10.5 million mistaken transfer for months, and the legal fight to recover it.

stories.title: The man who got $2.1 million for free from his bank and got away with it
stories.beat: The Australian man who exploited a bank error to access unlimited credit, spent $2.1 million, and had his convictions overturned.

stories.title: Dan Saunders ATM glitch - Wikipedia
stories.beat: The documented story of Dan Saunders, whose bank glitch let him withdraw far beyond his balance - the definitive account of the ATM error.

stories.title: Romanian mathematician hacked the lottery system
stories.beat: The Independent on Stefan Mandel, the Romanian economist who mathematically hacked lottery systems and won 14 times.

stories.title: The gambler who cracked the horse-racing code
stories.beat: The story of a gambler who used mathematics and data modeling to crack horse-racing betting - an advantage play against the bookmakers.

stories.title: Bill Benter: the gambler who beat horse racing with math
stories.beat: Bill Benter built a computer model that beat Hong Kong horse racing for decades, winning an estimated $1 billion - the ultimate advantage play.

stories.title: Blackjack player breaks the bank at Atlantic City
stories.beat: The card-counting saga of a blackjack player who legally beat casinos at Atlantic City and the ban that followed.
